: They'll pry Camille from my cold dead hands before I'll take her

: out of my V:TES Gangrel deck.

Our group is playing the "use all the cards you paid for" variant, which
means that use all the cards from Jyhad, Vampire, and Dark Sovereigns.
There is no good reason why people cannot use the cards. The only excuse
I could allow would be if your group is uncomfortable making decisions on
card use/timing etc on its own.

Granted, I've messed up people's games by specifically shuffing all their
VAMPIRE crypt cards to the bottom. ;) Also, if you have been playing a
long time with a group, others using VAMPIRE cards to add to their Jyhad
decks almost mark their own decks. You add the cards you need more of
right? So, its quite possible to guess what the VAMPIRE backed cards are
before they even get drawn.

My group passes their library and crypt to their prey for that player to
shuffle, sometimes it makes for very interesting games.

Remember, it is only a game. If you're getting in huge arguments over
it, perhaps you take it far too seriously.

Messages.Author: BSPA...@maine.maine.edu
Messages.Body:
Here's something I do about the different card backs.
Put in the cards you want, Jyhad, Vamp and DS.
Then shuffle your crypt and Lib. and cut each pile.
Now, just draw from the bottom of each pile.
You can get little plastic card trays to make this easier,
or put your deck near the edge of the table.
Now no one can see the backs of your cards unless they
are on the table or they look at your card hand.
This idea was originally posted on this group
before VTES was released. I cant remember the person's
name-but I must give them credit for this idea as it
is not my own.

BEN.S.

BSPA...@MAINE.maine.edu
